tools.name: ping
tools.description: Test connectivity to Grabblist and return service version.

tools.name: get_wishlist
tools.description: Get all saved items from the user's Grabblist. Each item is a static snapshot — data reflects the moment it was saved, not current prices.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get full details of a saved item by ID. Returns a static snapshot from the user's Grabblist.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Save an item to the user's Grabblist. Creates a static snapshot — Grabblist does not monitor prices or auto-update data. Only include fields with values available from the source. If no image is provided, the server attempts to fetch og:image automatically.

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: Remove one or more items from the user's Grabblist (soft-delete). Pass a single id or an array of ids for batch operations.

tools.name: restore_item
tools.description: Restore one or more deleted (archived) items back to the Grabblist. Pass a single id or an array of ids for batch restore.

tools.name: search_saved
tools.description: Search within the user's saved items by keyword

tools.name: update_price
tools.description: Manually update the price on a saved item. Records old and new price for comparison. This is a manual correction, not automatic price tracking.

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Edit fields on one or more saved items. Pass a single id or an array of ids for batch updates (same fields applied to all). For batch: attributes are REPLACED not merged, og:image fallback is skipped.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List all collections OR get a specific collection with its items. Without id: returns all collections with counts/values. With id: returns that collection's metadata and all items inside (with optional filters).

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create a new collection (folder) in the user's Grabblist to organize saved items.

tools.name: add_to_collection
tools.description: Add a saved item to a collection. Both the item and collection must already exist.

tools.name: remove_from_collection
tools.description: Remove one or more items from a collection. Pass a single item_id or an array of item_ids for batch removal. Items are NOT deleted — they stay in the Grabblist.

tools.name: delete_collection
tools.description: Permanently delete a collection. Items inside are not deleted — they stay in the Grabblist.

tools.name: update_collection
tools.description: Update a collection's name, icon, description, budget, or sharing status. Only provide the fields you want to change — omitted fields stay unchanged. Set is_public=true to share (returns public URL), is_public=false to unshare.

tools.name: link_items
tools.description: Create typed relations between items: alternative (A or B), complement (A and B together), upgrade (B replaces A), duplicate (same item different site), same_seller. Supports single pair (from_id, to_id, relation) or bulk (pairs array).

tools.name: get_item_graph
tools.description: Get all relations for an item — alternatives, complements, upgrades, duplicates. Returns the item and all connected items with their relation types.

tools.name: unlink_items
tools.description: Remove a relation between two items.

tools.name: get_item_history
tools.description: Get the change history for a saved item — who changed what and when.

tools.name: get_collection_activity
tools.description: Get recent activity on a collection — additions, removals, edits.

tools.name: set_pinned_items
tools.description: Set the pinned "Top Picks" items for a collection (max 3). Pinned items are highlighted on the share page.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Send feedback, bug report, or feature request to the Grabbit team. Use this when you encounter parsing failures, missing features, broken URLs, or have improvement suggestions. The team reads these to improve the product. Be specific about what went wrong and where.

tools.name: ask_agent
tools.description: Delegate a task to Grabblist's built-in AI assistant. The agent knows the user's Grabblist and can answer questions, compare items, give shopping advice, or analyze saved products. Use this when you want a second opinion or a specialized shopping assistant perspective. Requires the user to have an A
